{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the counts of -999 in biomarker_baseline
count_neg999 = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
total_rows = len(data)
percentage_neg999 = (count_neg999 / total_rows) * 100

print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {count_neg999}")
print(f"Total rows: {total_rows}")
print(f"Percentage of -999 values: {percentage_neg999:.1f}%")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
num_duplicates = data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id values: {num_duplicates}")

# Check the distribution of arm and severity
tab_arm_severity = pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['severity'])
print("\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity:")
print(tab_arm_severity)

# Check the distribution of assay_batch
print("\nAssay batch distribution:")
print(data['assay_batch'].value_counts())

# Check the range of sample_seq
print("\nSample sequence range:")
print(data['sample_seq'].min(), data['sample_seq'].max())"}
